description.value: Robin Ridge Winery is a small, family-operated organic estate winery on the Similkameen Bench near the junction of Hwy 3 and Hwy 3A in Keremeos, with 18 acres of vines farmed without synthetic chemicals or pesticides. Founded by Tim and Caroline Cottrill, the winery is best known for its award-winning Gamay and produces a broad range of varietals including Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Meritage, and a traditional Sparkling Finch. Cyclists exploring the Similkameen wine country will find a tasting room offering wines that aim to express the distinctive terroir of the valley.
